gems.name: asobi
gems.info: asobi (Japanese for 'play') is a Ruby library for creative coding and generative art with zero dependencies: it makes pictures and looping animations. A picture is a Ruby object: repeat a petal eight times, arrange the petals into a flower, and spin the whole flower. Give your own objects a visual form by defining to_art. Let a motion react to a click, the pointer, a key, the microphone or a song, and make notes and drum sounds, for live coding and VJ sets. Run the asobi command to see your sketch update in the browser as you edit. Export a still as SVG, or an animation as a standalone HTML file that still reacts and carries its song.
